command: set -eu; echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(id -un); echo SOURCE_REF=$(git rev-parse origin/main); for spec in 'werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh|/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh' 'werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py|/usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py' 'werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf|/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf' 'werkzeug/entityos-vm-semantic-cutover.conf|/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf'; do src=${spec%%|*}; dst=${spec#*|}; ssha=$(git show origin/main:$src | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); dsha=$(sha256sum $dst | awk '{print $1}'); echo BIND:$src:$ssha:$dst:$dsha; [ "$ssha" = "$dsha" ] || { echo BIND_MISMATCH:$src; exit 41; }; done; echo EFFECTIVE; printf 'ACTIVE='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value; printf 'PID='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value; printf 'EPOCH='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value; printf 'DROPINS='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p DropInPaths --value; printf 'EXECCONDITION='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecCondition --value; printf 'EXECSTOPPOST='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecStopPost --value; set +e; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py --config /etc/entityos/entityos.conf --service entityos-vm.service condition; rc=$?; set -e; echo CUTOVER_CONDITION_RC=$rc; case $rc in 0|255) ;; *) exit $rc;; esac; echo OMEGA_RUNTIME_BINDCHECK_PASS=1
